phrase.zh: 迟疑之间，仍要作出选择。
phrase.en: A choice still waits within doubt.

visual.zh: 巨大的骨色头骨裁切于左侧与下缘，右上斜放着较小的黄铜王冠；酒红绒带从头骨上缘绕向王冠，穿过画面中部。黑白版保留构图。三件物件借死亡、权力与牵连表达影片主题，是原创静物，并非电影道具或真实画面复刻。
visual.en: An enormous bone-colored skull is cropped at left and bottom, with a smaller tilted brass crown at upper right. A wine velvet ribbon runs from the skull’s upper edge toward the crown through the middle of the image. Monochrome retains the composition. Death, power and entanglement are original still-life metaphors, not film props or replicas of actual frames.

background.zh:
《哈姆雷特》由劳伦斯·奥利维尔执导并主演，1948年上映，在1949年第21届奥斯卡获最佳影片。英国电影协会的影片介绍记录了黑白影像、城堡走廊与楼梯，以及怀疑和死亡构成的氛围。插画用头骨、王冠与绒带作原创解读，彩色版的材质颜色不表示原片为彩色，也不声称使用了真实道具。短句为原创，不是莎士比亚台词或影片引语。
第21届奥斯卡最佳影片：哈姆雷特。颁奖年份 1949；参评年份 1948。
background.en:
Laurence Olivier directed and starred in Hamlet, released in 1948 and awarded Best Motion Picture at the 21st Academy Awards in 1949. BFI describes the stark black-and-white castle corridors and staircases, and the atmosphere of doubt and mortality. Skull, crown and ribbon form an original interpretation; the illustration’s material colors do not imply the film was in color or that these are actual props. The phrase is original, neither Shakespeare dialogue nor a film quotation.
Academy Awards ceremony 21 (1949), Best Picture: Hamlet. Eligibility year: 1948.
